entities.name: Sylvan Library
entities.description: Magical place inside a gigantic deformed tree in the woods of southern Argenti that grants knowledge and comprehension.

entities.name: Argenti
entities.description: Island on Dominaria where the library stands.

entities.name: Lord Magnus
entities.description: Archdruid and Argenti's forest avatar who protected the library and reincarnated there.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Came to Argenti to quell the uprising against the Empire of Madara.

entities.name: Empire of Madara
entities.description: Empire facing an uprising on Argenti.

entities.name: Kei Takahashi
entities.description: Infested with an eumidian parasite and left half-mutated.

events.summary: Magnus confronts Tetsuo Umezawa's party and is defeated, but returns after the Library reincarnates him.
events.quote: Magnus confronted the party and was defeated

events.summary: Magnus says the parasite can be stopped by separating and killing it; the process succeeds but leaves Kei half-mutated.
events.quote: left Kei in a half-mutated state

relations.quote: the Sylvan Library was protected by the archdruid Lord Magnus
